title: Spot capacity ladder scenarios sheet
content:
Purpose:
Simple spreadsheet-style scenario bank for matching spot bid curves to expected capacity demand, and estimating end-to-end cost and outage risk across fallback tiers and regions. This is a working sheet for the Optimize team to iterate on heuristics before we codify into the routing policy engine.

Assumptions (editable):
- baseline ondemand_price_per_gpu_hr = $3.20 (n1-standard eq)
- baseline spot_price_mean_per_gpu_hr by region provided in separate price feed (column H)
- qps -> GPUs mapping: required_gpus = CEILING(requested_qps / gpu_qps_capacity) where gpu_qps_capacity default=120 qps per GPU for gen-3 models
- eviction_probability = min(0.6, 0.02 * bid_discount_pct_over_ondemand) simple heuristic for now
- prewarm_cost per node = 0.1 * ondemand_price_per_gpu_hr for small prewarm instances

Columns (this sheet modeled as table rows):
- ScenarioID: short id (S001)
- Region: string (us-west1, eu-central1, ap-southeast1)
- AppCriticality: high | medium | low (used to set safety margin)
- TrafficPattern: steady | diurnal | spiky
- PeakQPS: numeric
- PreferredTier: on-demand | reserved | spot-primary
- SpotBidPctOfOnDemand: numeric (e.g. 30 means 30% of on-demand)
- ExpectedEvictionProb: formula -> =MIN(0.95, 0.02 * (100 - SpotBidPctOfOnDemand)) (percentage)
content_addendum:
- GPUsNeeded = =CEILING(PeakQPS / gpu_qps_capacity)
- PrimaryCapacityCostPerHr = GPUsNeeded * IF(PreferredTier="spot-primary", SpotBidPctOfOnDemand/100 * OndemandPrice, OndemandPrice)
- FallbackPlan: ordered list like [reserved@regionX, ondemand@regionY, fallback-spot@regionZ] (store as comma-separated string)
- ExpectedEffectiveCapacity = GPUsNeeded * (1 - ExpectedEvictionProb) + PrewarmNodes (if prewarm true)
- EstimatedAvgLatencyMs = BaseLatencyByRegion + LatencyDeltaForRemoteFallback*NumFallbackHops
- CostPerMillionTokens = =PrimaryCapacityCostPerHr / (TokensPerHourByModel * 1e-6) -- tokens/hr estimate from qps*avg_tokens

Sample rows (human-readable):
S001, us-west1, high, spiky, 4800, spot-primary, 35, 0.6, reserved@us-west1, ondemand@us-east1, 40 GPUs needed -> primary cost = 40 * (0.35 * 3.20) = $44.80/hr; expected capacity after evictions = 16 GPUs (unhealthy) so fallback to 10 reserved nodes -> blended cost = primary_active_cost + reserved_cost; notes: increase prewarm to 8 nodes for 95pct SLO
S002, eu-central1, medium, diurnal, 1200, spot-primary, 50, 0.2, ondemand@eu-central1, spot@eu-west1, 10 GPUs needed -> cost comp favorable to spot; eviction low; recommend 20% prewarm threshold
S003, ap-southeast1, low, steady, 300, spot-primary, 20, 0.6, spot@ap-southeast1, ondemand@ap-southeast1, 3 GPUs needed -> cost savings high but eviction risk high; recommend route to reserved for SLA-bound customers

Key metrics the sheet computes per-scenario (spreadsheet formulas explained):
- HourlyPrimaryCost = GPUsNeeded * SpotOrOnDemandPricePerGPU
- HourlyFallbackCost = sum(GPUsFallback_i * PriceFallback_i)
- BlendedHourlyCost = HourlyPrimaryCost * (1 - ExpectedEvictionProb) + HourlyFallbackCost * ExpectedEvictionProb
- LatencyImpactScore = WeightedSum(latency_ms_primary * (1 - eviction_prob) + latency_ms_fallback * eviction_prob)
- CostPerRequest = BlendedHourlyCost / (requests_per_hour) -> convert to $/1M tokens as needed

Mini-sim block (instructions for quick monte-carlo in sheet):
- sample N rows per scenario with random eviction ~ Bernoulli(p=ExpectedEvictionProb) and random spot_price ~ Normal(mean=SpotBidPctOfOnDemand*OndemandPrice, sd=0.05*OndemandPrice)
- for each draw compute whether fallback triggers and total cost; aggregate percentiles (P50,P95) of cost and latency

Preliminary recommendations (work in progress):
- For spiky/high-criticality workloads: prefer hybrid-primary with 25% reserved buffer in-region + spot primary. This keeps P95 latency within SLO while preserving cost savings on avg.
- For diurnal medium workloads: increase spot bid to 45-55% to reduce eviction probability; use cross-region ondemand fallback only for short bursts.
- For low-criticality, steady workloads: can default to spot at aggressive bids (<=30%) but enforce automated quiet-hours migration to cheaper reserved capacity where available.

Open questions / TODOs:
- calibrate eviction model with real market history (last 90 days) per region and instance family.
- compute tokens/hr conversions per model variant and expose per-model cost rows.
- build a small test harness to run the mini-sim in airflow weekly and populate a dashboard for P50/P95 cost deltas.

Next steps / owner action items:
- Priya: hook up spot price feed and replace heuristic price numbers (due 2025-11-15)
- Ethan: prototype monte-carlo tab and sample 10k draws for top 20 customer traffic shapes (due 2025-12-01)
- Sofia: validate latency deltas for cross-region fallbacks with SRE (due 2025-11-22)

Notes on how this differs from other docs:
- focused on matching spot bid curves to capacity sizing rather than pure regional bid-sensitivity; emphasizes blended-cost math and small monte-carlo sim to produce P95 risk-adjusted cost numbers suitable for routing policy thresholds.

References and quick links:
